Connecting customer strategy with implementation

Moving from a commercial objective to a coordinated transformation.

The objective

Improve sales conversion and operating efficiency through better digital customer engagement at a major credit-card business.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led work to define a new customer-relationship strategy, select a supporting solution, build the business case and develop and implement the transformation roadmap.

The outcome

The CV reports an 11% revenue impact through improved opportunity conversion and approximately 20% lower operating costs.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Maintaining continuity from strategy and investment decisions through implementation and business change.
